title: Desecration of the Temple: the "abomination of desolation" (15 Chislev 145 SE, 168/167 BC)
summary: Under Antiochus IV the regular offerings were stopped and on 15 Chislev of Seleucid year 145 an "abomination of desolation" was built on the altar at Jerusalem; pagan sacrifices began ten days later.
external_reason: Proposed as the fulfilment of Dan 11:31 (and 8:11–13; 9:27; 12:11) by preterist interpreters; cited by Matt 24:15 for a later desolation.

mentions.notes: Jesus refers to "the abomination of desolation, spoken of through Daniel".

scripture_extraction.reason: External historical event, researched because interpreters read Daniel 11 as foretelling it; no biblical narrative of it in the 66-book index.
